<thought>From the mapped reaction for template 1914391, the left‑hand side provides the two reactant SMILES (with atom‑mapping). By removing the mapping indices and keeping stereochemistry, the precursors are:
1. Sugar‑derived fragment: CCOC(=O)C[C@H]1CC[C@H](O)C(C)C@@H(C=O)O1
2. Phosphonate alkyne fragment: C[C@H](P(=O)(OCC(F)(F)F)OCC(F)(F)F)C#COC

Thus the list of possible precursor combinations is a single list containing these two SMILES.</thought>
<final_answer>[['CCOC(=O)C[C@H]1CC[C@H](O)C(C)C@@H(C=O)O1', 'C[C@H](P(=O)(OCC(F)(F)F)OCC(F)(F)F)C#COC']]</final_answer>
